method: Album-level editorial review of broad Discogs search matches. Overrides require positive musical-style evidence; a title match can be rejected when the playlist track is absent from the matched release.

4wPytOTUM9zioXrAbqp7mG.rationale: The artist release page tags the album world, Mediterranean, and psychedelic folk rock and quotes a four-star Songlines review; Discogs independently matches the album under its broad Folk, World & Country umbrella.

3aKIvmIRJ32Gr8Fq4mIRiv.rationale: The exact release notes describe West African music combining northern Ghanaian traditions with southern Ghanaian Azonto and Hiplife; Discogs styles include African and Tribal alongside Hip Hop.

6ciE9GJFhZntxPoS8OLMZS.rationale: The artist page describes the project as musicians from Iran, Turkey, and Iraq working across Kurdish regional styles and explicitly places it in world music; Discogs exactly matches Kobane.

6hzZlHtRhz8uRcFiecg3kB.rationale: The exact release is a Papua New Guinea stringband collection issued by Riverboat Records / World Music Network; its track list matches the playlist album.

4bUk1m4hzKtdlp8knuxPw3.rationale: Spotify's exact album track list contains Jajouka Black Eyes (Rhaitas), and the artist's SoundCloud identifies the track as World Music. The similarly titled Discogs electronic release 831052 has a different track list and is rejected as evidence for this album.
